sources.title: The OpenGL ES Shading Language, Version 3.00.6
relevantContract: integer operations wrap to the low n bits on overflow or underflow
int/uint conversions preserve the bit pattern
signed right shift sign-extends and unsigned right shift zero-fills
negative or out-of-range shift counts are undefined

sources.authority: W3C GPU for the Web Working Group
sources.title: WebGPU Shading Language, Candidate Recommendation Draft 15 September 2026
relevantContract: i32 and u32 are concrete 32-bit integer types
runtime shift counts are reduced modulo the bit width
constant and override shift counts at or above the bit width are errors
bitcast reinterprets the underlying bit representation

scope: language semantics only; not runtime, statistical quality, collision resistance or production adoption evidence
